items.title: Respond to employer's offer on salary conversion (Entgeltumwandlung)
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns Ihre Entscheidung bitte binnen 10 Arbeitstagen ab dem Briefdatum mit.
items.computation: Letter date (Briefdatum) is 11.05.2027 (Tuesday). This is a private deadline between employer and employee, counted in 'Arbeitstagen' (business days, Mon-Fri, public holidays excluded, per the letter's own definition). Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (11.05.2027) is not counted, so counting starts on 12.05.2027 (Wed). Counting only Mon-Fri and skipping public holidays: 12.05 (Wed)=1, 13.05 (Thu)=2, 14.05 (Fri)=3, 15-16.05 weekend skipped, 17.05 (Mon) is Whit Monday (Pfingstmontag, nationwide holiday, Easter 2027=28.03 +50 days) so skipped, 18.05 (Tue)=4, 19.05 (Wed)=5, 20.05 (Thu)=6, 21.05 (Fri)=7, 22-23.05 weekend skipped, 24.05 (Mon)=8, 25.05 (Tue)=9, 26.05 (Wed)=10. The 10th working day is 26.05.2027. Since the period is counted directly in working days (not a calendar period whose end merely falls on a non-working day), no further §193 BGB adjustment is needed because the 10th counted day is already a Wednesday.

items.title: Start date of salary conversion (Direktversicherung) if employee opts in
items.quote: ab dem 01.07.2027 können Sie einen Teil Ihres Bruttogehalts in eine Direktversicherung einzahlen.
items.computation: Date given explicitly in the letter as the start of the benefit, contingent on the employee's prior opt-in decision (see deadline above); no counting required, used as stated.
